<!-- Shared body of each comparison page. Each page sets `branch` and `type`
     and includes this file. -->

```{r}
#| include: false
# Use a local biocUniTools checkout if BIOCUNITOOLS_SRC points to one, so
# changes to its R/ show up without reinstalling
src <- Sys.getenv("BIOCUNITOOLS_SRC")
if (nzchar(src)) {
    pkgload::load_all(src, quiet = TRUE)
} else {
    library(biocUniTools)
}
config <- yaml::read_yaml("../config.yml")
data_file <- file.path("..", config$data_dir,
                       sprintf("compare-%s-%s.rds", branch, type))
has_data <- file.exists(data_file)
old_data <- FALSE
if (has_data) {
    cmp <- readRDS(data_file)
    # Data saved by an older biocUniTools may lack columns this page uses
    old_data <- !all(c("uni_source_build", "uni_check_diverged") %in% names(cmp))
    has_data <- !old_data
}
compared <- if (type == "workflows")
    "BBS `R CMD build` and R Universe source `R CMD build`" else
    "BBS `R CMD check` and R Universe `R CMD check`"
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
if (old_data) {
    cat("The saved data is from an older version of biocUniTools. Update",
        "biocUniTools and run",
        "`biocUniTools::write_comparisons(\"reports/config.yml\")` again.\n")
} else if (!has_data) {
    cat("No data yet. Run `biocUniTools::write_comparisons(\"reports/config.yml\")`.\n")
}
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
if (has_data) compare_header(cmp)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
if (has_data) compare_bars(cmp)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
if (has_data) compare_details(cmp)
```

<details>
<summary>Legend</summary>

- **Same result**: `r compared` (the shaded columns) agree. NOTE is treated
  as OK; WARNING(S) are treated the same.
- **Status**: R Universe's overall result for the package: success or failure.
- **Source build**: R Universe `R CMD build` of the source package, which
  builds vignettes.
- **Binary check**: `R CMD check` associated with the binary.
- **Download rank**: Bioconductor's rank among packages of this type by
  distinct IPs in the last 12 months, as on bioconductor.org package pages. 1
  is the most downloaded.
- **Downloads / month**: distinct IPs in the last 12 months divided by 12.
- **Strong reverse deps**: Bioconductor packages that depend on, import, or
  link to the package. Expand a row to see them and the packages that suggest
  it.

From R Universe:

- **Used by** (`_usedby`): packages anywhere in R Universe that use the
  package.
- **Mentions** (`_mentions`): mentions in scientific papers.
- **Score** (`_score`): R Universe's package score.
- **Commits (12 weeks)** (`_updates`): commits in the last 12 weeks.

</details>
